body:
MADISON, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) today announced U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) consolidated unaudited earnings per share (EPS) of $1.52 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.09 for the third quarter of 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, Alliant Energy reported EPS of $3.04, a 17% increase from $2.59 for the same period in 2025. Ongoing EPS for the first nine months of 2026 was $2.99, a 14% increase from $2.62 for the [...] HOQUIAM, Wash., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Timberland Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: TSBK) (“Timberland” or “the Company”), the holding company for Timberland Bank (the “Bank”), today reported net income of $31.17 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 7% from $29.16 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025. Earnings per diluted common share (“EPS”) increased 8% to $3.96 for the 2026 fiscal year from $3.67 for the 2025 fiscal year...
